# Forecasting eligibility review

This review closes the current offline forecasting candidate pass. It distinguishes
completed work from support gaps; neither pending independent review nor the protected
confirmation cohort was used as a universal blocker.

| Candidate | Result | Evidence |
|---|---|---|
| Residual-layer comparison | Already complete; no duplicate run | `CURRENCY_PROJECTION_RESIDUAL_REPAIR_20260925_000700`; 3,786 learned rows and 126 paired rows |
| Curve-shape comparison | Unsupported matched controls | curve begins 1722405660; signed/magnitude controls end 1721995260; zero exact keys |
| Rich-feature incremental comparison | Already complete; no duplicate fit | `RICH_FAMILY_COMPARISON_20260922_073907` and `RICH_DEPENDENCE_20260922_081507` |
| Distinct-method comparison | No preserved third exact-provenance method | ridge and recovered HGB are the existing two baselines |
| Reduced residual-curve successor | Unsupported inherited chronology | residual 360m has seven origins; maximum multi-horizon panel has one origin; minimum is eight origins |

The original eight-horizon residual-curve experiment remains a completed negative
support result. Its issued residual support declines from 946 at 360m to zero at 2880m;
shortening its horizon grid cannot meet the inherited eight-origin rule. No fit, API,
broker/service/account action, policy replay, or live-bot change occurred in this
review. GPT/advisor comparisons remain deferred.

The next new research requires a separately frozen candidate contract with a material
input/cohort change, explicit resource bounds, matched controls, and retained
chronology. This review does not authorize such a fit.
